name: LLM Usage Dashboard
install: go env -w GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.8 && go mod download && go build -o /tmp/llmdash .

terminals.name: dashboard
terminals.command: DASH_USER=demo@example.com DASH_PASS=demo-pass SESSION_SECRET=dev-secret PORT=8080 go run .
terminals.description: Runs the Go dashboard server on http://localhost:8080 with dev login demo@example.com / demo-pass. No MONGODB_URI is set, so it uses the in-memory store (data resets on restart). Set MONGODB_URI to use MongoDB Atlas.
